blocks.content:
Instead of browsing folders, describe what you need in plain language. Assistant can find dashboards, list data sources, and open Explore with a query already loaded.

Stay in **Assistant** mode for this path (switch back from Learn or other modes if needed).

whenTrue.content: If this guide is docked in the sidebar, pop it out into a floating window so it stays visible when **Assistant** opens.

blocks.content: To find a resource with Assistant, complete the following steps:
Open **Assistant** from the top toolbar (sparkle icon). You can also select **Assistant** from the left navigation.
blocks.hint: Skip if the Assistant panel is already open.

blocks.content:
In the chat input, paste or type a prompt that matches your environment:

> List Prometheus data sources available to me.

> Find dashboards tagged "production" that include checkout metrics.

> List data sources available to me.
Click **Send** (the arrow next to the chat input).

Review the reply.

Check that the resources or links match what you asked for. When a dashboard opens from the reply, the current time range stays the same.

You should see matching resources or a link you can open. Results depend on what exists in your stack.

For more prompts, refer to [Navigate Grafana resources](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/assistant/guides/navigation/).

whenTrue.content: Dock this guide back to the sidebar when you are ready for the next milestone.
